summary_fr: Administration institutionnelle des baux, actifs et portefeuilles.

tools.name: ARGUS Enterprise
tools.positioning: The cash-flow model the industry agreed to standardise on — a valuation is credible partly because it is an ARGUS file.
tools.description: ARGUS Enterprise models commercial property cash flows lease by lease: rent steps, recoveries, renewal probabilities, capital expenditure and debt, producing valuations, hold-sell analysis and portfolio consolidation. Its file format is a de facto industry exchange standard.
tools.real_estate_use: When an asset trades, the seller's broker sends an ARGUS file and the buyer re-underwrites in the same tool. That shared format is most of the value — assumptions are visible and comparable rather than buried in someone's private spreadsheet. Appraisers, lenders and fund managers use it for the same reason.
features: Lease-by-lease commercial cash flow modelling
Recovery structures, rent steps and market leasing assumptions
Valuation by discounted cash flow and direct capitalisation
Debt, equity waterfall and hold-sell analysis
Portfolio consolidation and scenario comparison
Industry-standard file exchange with counterparties

use_cases.job: Underwrite an acquisition from the seller's own cash flow model
Produce a valuation in the format lenders and auditors expect

tools.name: Eudonet Immobilier
tools.positioning: A configurable French CRM with a real estate vertical — for organisations whose process does not fit an agency package.
tools.description: Eudonet is a French CRM platform sold in vertical editions, including one for real estate professionals: contact and asset relationship management, prospect and mandate pipelines, campaign management, and configurable objects and workflows, hosted in France.
tools.real_estate_use: It is chosen by organisations that are not classic agencies — institutional owners, developers, public bodies, networks — whose relationship processes do not match a transaction package. The configurability is the point: an object model for buildings, tenants, prospects and operations can be shaped to the organisation rather than the reverse, with French hosting satisfying public procurement requirements.
features: Configurable object model for assets, contacts and operations
Prospect, mandate and opportunity pipelines
Campaign, email and event management
Workflow automation and validation circuits
Reporting and dashboards per business line
French hosting and public sector compliance

use_cases.job: Model relationships around assets and operations rather than around a sales pipeline
Track prospects and reservations on a development programme in a configurable CRM

tools.name: HappyCo
tools.positioning: Maintenance and asset-condition platform for multifamily operators, built around mobile inspections, work orders and unit turns.
tools.description: HappyCo is an operations platform for multifamily owners and property managers organized into several suites: maintenance operations (preventive maintenance, work orders, make-readies, inspections and reporting), an after-hours answering and triage service that turns resident calls into work orders, asset management covering capital budgets, renovation projects, vendor compliance and inventory, asset evaluation for due diligence and lease-file audits, and a sourcing module for vendor bidding. Its mobile apps work offline and sync when connectivity returns, and it integrates with the main property management systems as a certified partner. A separate lending suite connects to Freddie Mac's Optigo network for origination inspections.
tools.real_estate_use: A regional manager responsible for several thousand apartments cannot personally see the condition of any of them. Their onsite technicians run every inspection — move-in, move-out, life safety, make-ready — inside the HappyCo mobile app, which timestamps photos and pushes the result back with no paper. When a unit is vacated, the make-ready workflow assigns the punch list and the manager watches the turn close in a dashboard rather than by phone. At acquisition, the same apps are used for due-diligence walks and lease-file audits so the buyer's condition assessment sits in the system the operator will use afterwards. Overnight resident calls are triaged by the answering service and arrive the next morning as work orders already routed.
features: Mobile inspections with timestamped photos and offline sync
Work orders, preventive maintenance schedules and make-ready turn tracking
After-hours call triage that generates work orders automatically
Capital budget, renovation project and vendor compliance tracking
Due-diligence and lease-file audit workflows for acquisitions
Benchmarking dashboards across properties, units and staff

use_cases.job: Run move-in, move-out and life-safety inspections on mobile and close a unit turn against a tracked punch list
Schedule preventive maintenance and dispatch work orders to onsite technicians across a portfolio
Carry out due-diligence walks and lease-file audits on an acquisition inside the platform the operator will keep using

integrations: Certified integrations with leading property management systems

tools.name: MRI Software
tools.positioning: The open alternative to a single-vendor stack — bring your own best-of-breed and let MRI hold the lease and the ledger.
tools.description: MRI Software provides property and lease management, accounting, investment management, facilities and workplace products across commercial and residential real estate worldwide. Its stated strategy is an open platform: published APIs and a partner ecosystem rather than a closed suite.
tools.real_estate_use: A European or transatlantic owner often cannot standardise on one vendor — local accounting, local leasing practice and existing systems all resist it. MRI is chosen when the lease and financial core must be common while country teams keep their own tools around it. In France it supports local lease and accounting requirements alongside Anglo-Saxon reporting.
features: Commercial and residential lease and property management
Real estate accounting with multi-entity and multi-currency
Investment management and investor reporting
Facilities management and workplace modules
Lease accounting compliance for IFRS 16 and ASC 842
Open APIs and a partner integration ecosystem

use_cases.job: Consolidate a cross-border portfolio while local teams keep their own tools
Meet IFRS 16 lease accounting obligations from the lease system itself

tools.name: Visual Lease
tools.positioning: Lease accounting compliance first — for the tenant side, where a lease is a balance sheet liability.
tools.description: Visual Lease is a lease administration and lease accounting platform aimed at occupiers and corporate real estate teams. It maintains a lease repository with critical dates and clauses, and produces the journal entries and disclosures required by ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87.
tools.real_estate_use: Since IFRS 16 and ASC 842, a company that rents two hundred stores carries those leases on its balance sheet, and the auditor tests the calculation. Visual Lease exists because that computation cannot survive in a spreadsheet: every modification, renewal option and discount rate change has to be re-measured and evidenced.
features: Central lease repository with clauses and critical dates
ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87 calculation and disclosure reporting
Journal entry generation and ERP export
Lease modification and remeasurement handling
Rent payment scheduling and recovery review
Portfolio dashboards for occupancy cost

use_cases.job: Produce audit-ready lease accounting entries for a multi-country lease portfolio
Never miss a renewal or break option across hundreds of sites

tools.name: VTS
tools.positioning: The leasing pipeline for office landlords — every tour, proposal and lease in one view, plus a demand index nobody else has.
tools.description: VTS is a leasing and asset management platform for commercial landlords: deal pipeline, space availability, tenant and broker activity, portfolio reporting, and the VTS Market and Activate products covering marketing and tenant experience. Its VTS Office Demand Index derives leading indicators from platform activity.
tools.real_estate_use: Office leasing runs on a pipeline that traditionally lived in a leasing director's spreadsheet. VTS makes it institutional: every requirement, tour and proposal is tracked, so an asset manager can forecast occupancy and compare a proposed deal against portfolio standards. Because a large share of US office space transacts on the platform, aggregated tour activity becomes a market signal weeks ahead of signed-lease data.
features: Leasing deal pipeline with tours, proposals and approvals
Space availability and stacking plans
Portfolio occupancy and lease expiry reporting
VTS Market for online marketing of available space
VTS Activate tenant experience application
Office Demand Index from aggregated platform activity

use_cases.job: Forecast occupancy from a real leasing pipeline rather than from a spreadsheet
Track every requirement and proposal on a landlord's portfolio in one system

tools.name: Yardi Voyager
tools.positioning: The institutional system of record — where the lease, the ledger and the investor report are the same data.
tools.description: Voyager is Yardi's enterprise platform, deployed across commercial, multifamily, affordable, senior and student portfolios worldwide. It combines property accounting, lease administration, budgeting and forecasting, investment management and a large ecosystem of add-on modules, with localisations including France.
tools.real_estate_use: For an institutional owner, the question is not features but audit chain: the rent invoiced to a tenant, the indexation clause applied, the accrual booked and the figure reported to the fund's investors must all descend from one record. Voyager is bought for that continuity, and implementations run in months because the configuration encodes a firm's entire operating model.
features: Commercial and residential lease administration with clause handling
Property, corporate and investment accounting with multi-currency
Budgeting, forecasting and valuation workflows
Investment management and investor reporting
Maintenance, procurement and energy modules
Country localisations including French accounting and VAT treatment

use_cases.job: Report to fund investors from the same ledger that invoices the tenants
Administer indexation, recoveries and CAM reconciliation across a commercial portfolio
